fields.summary: TC-860-02: Blaze Call Not Skipped When Trip Has Mix of Flying and NonFly Legs

content.text: Linked Story: CREWCMBR-860
Precondition: A trip exists with a mix of Flying legs and NonFly legs across DPs. Since not all legs are NonFly, the Blaze call must NOT be skipped - normal audit processing must proceed.
TEST STEPS
Step
Action
Test Data
Expected Result
Set up a trip with DP1 containing a Flying leg and DP2 containing a NonFly (SIM) leg
Trip: DP1 Leg1 legType=Flying (DAL->HOU). DP2 Leg1 legType=SIM. auditNeeded=true
Trip record created in DynamoDB with mixed leg types
Trigger the Phase 2 audit workflow for the mixed-leg trip
Phase 2 audit triggered with all toggles enabled and trip release time passed
Phase 2 audit workflow invoked
Verify the audit Lambda does NOT skip Blaze because not all legs are NonFly (at least one Flying leg exists)
Audit Lambda leg type check: DP1 has Flying leg - condition for skip NOT met
Audit Lambda does not apply the all-NonFly skip logic and proceeds to invoke the Blaze Pull Lambda
Verify the Blaze Pull Lambda is invoked for the mixed-leg trip
CloudWatch Logs for crew-qa2-techp-cmn-blaze-pull Lambda during audit
Blaze Pull Lambda is invoked and processes the trip - execution logged in CloudWatch
Verify audit completes with status Completed and pay override is applied for the flying leg as appropriate
DynamoDB audit record and COA Search App after audit for mixed-leg trip
Audit status=Completed and applicable pay overrides are applied for the Flying leg in the mixed-leg trip
